title: Brookfield Farms Equestrian Center
specs: State-of-the-art indoor riding arena 200' x 100' with Cover-All® roof
Facility includes 36 stalls, 8 pastures with automatic waterers
In-house lesson horse shows several times per year
Beginners must be at least 5 years old
blurb: Brookfield Farms Equestrian Center offers horse riding lessons for all ages and skill levels, including private, semi-private, and group lessons. The facility includes a state-of-the-art indoor arena, outdoor arena, heated tack rooms, and boarding services with 12'x12' stalls and pastures. They also host horse riding clinics, training, leasing, sales, and in-house horse shows.
extraNote: Weekly lessons require application via online form; single lessons not available through application · Contact for stall rental rates and boarder co-op details
